import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = len(s)
    ans = 0
    
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        count = 1
        while i + 1 < n and s[i] == s[i + 1]:
            count += 1
            i += 1
        if count % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i += 1
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
